newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's President Scalfaro receives Prodi.
newsitem.headline: Italy's President Scalfaro receives Prodi.

text.p: Italian President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro met Prime Minister Romano Prodi and cabinet undersecretary Enrico Micheli on Thursday, the president's office said in a statement.
As is customary, it gave no details of the talks.
Prodi earlier held a "long and cordial" telephone conversation with French President Jacques Chirac, the government said.
Chirac telephoned Prodi to discuss economic and monetary questions and NATO issues and both men reaffirmed their commitment to join the single currency on schedule in 1999.
Prodi was due to answer questions on EMU in the Senate (upper house) at 1430 GMT.
